disconfirming_evidence: CoinDesk's PoR review identifies Binance 14 as an Ethereum wallet; it does not establish that five XRPL source wallets appear in Binance's PoR set.
Binance's official page exposes an address-download control, but the underlying file was not retrieved; search-index absence is not proof of address absence.
The ETH reserve-coverage estimate is asset-specific and cannot be extrapolated to XRP.
October 29 ETF flows precede the first identified XRP drain at 20:05 UTC; they are not an observed reaction to the incident.
Alpha Finance's modelled liquidation heatmap is not executable order-book liquidity; OI values from different providers are not comparable without normalization.
Binance's aggregate promise to cover losses does not prove XRP purchases, XRP-specific replenishment or recovered assets.
